title: Use categorized logging and keep Release console output minimal
source: Use categorised loggers to suppress debug prints. On Release there should be very little to print on the console.
scope: User selected implementation alongside UX-006/UI-034; review and categorize application diagnostics without a custom logging framework.
expected: Normal Release use produces very little console output. Useful development diagnostics remain selectively available by category, while actionable warnings and errors remain observable.
review_points: Inventory qDebug/qInfo/qWarning/qCritical and QML console output, distinguishing app diagnostics from Qt or platform messages.
Choose a small, useful QLoggingCategory set and Release defaults; avoid a custom logging framework or blanket suppression of failures.
Keep Debug output useful and document how to enable individual categories for troubleshooting.
Verify a Release normal-use flow is quiet and controlled failure cases still emit actionable diagnostics.

validation.before: tests/test_release_logging.py fails release_normal_startup_is_quiet against the original diagnostics; legacy default-category database/model messages are captured in out/ux006-dev013-ui034/logging-before.
validation.after: All seven blackbox checks pass after the final build: quiet Release, opt-in diagnostics, runtime CMake version, independent category selection, actionable storage failure, Debug defaults and Debug suppression. Report: out/ux006-dev013-ui034/logging-includes/results.json.
validation.models: Debug and Release model CTest entries pass; seven Windows interaction/model/rendering entries pass. Normal Release model cleanup stays quiet unless diagnostics are enabled.
validation.analysis: clang-tidy and Clazy pass all six production translation units with the Samuel baseline. Direct public includes added for logging macros/types. Reports: out/ux006-dev013-ui034/analysis-final.
validation.limits: Verification covers application-owned diagnostics. Existing framework/platform warnings are retained. No blanket log suppression or global handler was added.

implementation: qshopper.app and qshopper.model QLoggingCategory objects default to Debug messages in Debug and warnings in Release. Converted all app C++ diagnostics, including license reads; routine dropped-table notices are debug diagnostics. No QML console output was found. Qt/platform logs remain unaffected. Runtime QT_LOGGING_RULES can select categories independently.
